column1: # Fixed OMA species trees for the 10-species reference set
#   BRAFL CALMI CAPTE DROME HUMAN LEPOC LOTGI MONBE MOUSE NEMVE
# one row per target lineage; TARGET is replaced by the target's OMA prefix.
# make_oma_db_files.pl looks up the target's ncbi-taxon-id (datastore metadata.yaml) in
# /n/sci/SCI-004223-SBGENOMES/dev/smr_dev/moop/ncbi_taxonomy/, walks up its NCBI lineage, and uses the first (most specific) row whose
# taxid is an ancestor. Rows are matched by taxid only; their order here does not matter.
# Reference backbone (rooted on the choanoflagellate MONBE):
# tetrapod puts the target as sister to (HUMAN,MOUSE): right for reptiles, amphibians, birds and
# non-Euarchontoglires mammals (bats, marsupials). A primate or rodent target sits inside
# flatworm follows Platyhelminthes as sister to Mollusca+Annelida (Rouphozoa vs Lophotrochozoa).
